segments.texte: Odin, le plus puissant des dieux nordiques… n'a qu'*un* *seul* *œil*.

clips.prompt: Extreme close-up of the face of Odin, very old powerful Norse god, long silver-white beard, dark blue hooded cloak with gold runic embroidery, wide-brimmed hat; his left eye is hidden in deep shadow, his right eye glows faintly gold, slow push-in

segments.texte: Et cet œil, il l'a *sacrifié* lui-même.

clips.prompt: Odin standing alone on a cliff at night, cloak and beard blowing in the wind, holding a tall wooden spear, storm clouds lit by golden lightning, camera slowly orbits around him

segments.texte: Sous une racine d'*Yggdrasil*, l'arbre qui porte les neuf mondes, coule une source : le puits de *Mímir*.

clips.prompt: Gigantic cosmic ash tree Yggdrasil whose branches hold nine glowing worlds in a starry midnight-blue sky, golden light running through its bark, slow upward tilt
A sacred well hidden beneath a colossal tree root in a misty cavern, the water glows with liquid gold light, ancient runes carved in the stones around it, slow dolly forward

segments.texte: Qui boit son eau reçoit toute la *sagesse* de l'univers.

clips.prompt: Macro shot of glowing golden water rippling in a stone well, swirling constellations and runes reflected in the surface, magical particles rising

segments.texte: Mais son gardien ne donne rien gratuitement. Son prix : *un* *œil*.

clips.prompt: Mímir, an ancient wise giant with pale grey skin, a long beard like tree roots and glowing gold eyes, half-merged with the stone wall of a cavern beside a glowing well, he slowly opens his eyes and looks at the camera

segments.texte: Odin n'hésite pas. Il arrache son œil… et le jette au fond du puits.

clips.prompt: Odin kneeling at the edge of a glowing golden well, he raises his hand to his face in determination, dramatic shadow hides the gesture, intense golden light from below on his face, no gore
A small glowing golden orb falls in slow motion into dark water of a sacred well, creating rings of golden light that spread across the surface

segments.texte: Puis il boit. Et soudain, il voit *tout* : le passé, les secrets des mondes…

clips.prompt: Odin, now one-eyed with a dark leather eyepatch, drinks golden water from a horn, a burst of golden light and runes explodes around him, visions of galaxies swirl, camera pulls back fast

segments.texte: … et même le *Ragnarök*, la fin qui l'attend.

clips.prompt: Apocalyptic vision of Ragnarök, a giant wolf silhouette howling against a burning sky, a world serpent rising from a stormy sea, gods' halls in flames, dark blue and gold palette, slow pan

segments.texte: Depuis, deux corbeaux, *Huginn* la Pensée et *Muninn* la Mémoire, parcourent le monde pour lui.

clips.prompt: Two large black ravens with blue-black iridescent feathers fly over misty Nordic mountains and fjords at golden dusk, tracking shot following them
Two black ravens land on the shoulders of one-eyed Odin seated on a high stone throne, one raven leans to whisper in his ear, golden candlelight, slow push-in

segments.texte: Un œil en moins… pour voir plus *loin* que tous les autres.

clips.prompt: Silhouette of one-eyed Odin with his spear and two ravens standing on a mountain peak, facing an immense golden sunrise above a sea of clouds, epic wide shot, slow zoom out

segments.texte: Et ce n'était que son *premier* sacrifice… Abonne-toi pour la suite.
